name: B10-0128/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Repression by the Ortega-Murillo regime in Nicaragua, targeting human rights defenders, political opponents and religious communities in particular
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on repression by the Ortega-Murillo regime in Nicaragua, targeting human rights defenders, political opponents and religious communities in particular
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Nicaragua's government to undo a constitutional reform that removes checks on power and bans strikes. It asks Nicaragua to stop persecuting opponents, religious groups and rights defenders, to release 45 political prisoners, and to restore nationality to over 450 people who lost it. It also asks the European Union to keep supporting people inside Nicaragua and in exile, and to hold the government accountable.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; these are requests, not laws.
- **Who it affects:** Nicaragua's government, prisoners, exiled and stateless people.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to EU institutions and Nicaraguan authorities; no binding action follows.
